snippet.title: Fraymakers Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: May 2025
snippet.description:
Fraymakers is the ultimate customizable platform fighting game, featuring a cast of some of indie gaming's biggest icons. Duke it out with up to 4 players and call on assists to help out in the heat of battle. Create and play custom characters, stages, modes, and more for infinite fun!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1420350/Fraymakers/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.

Love indie games? Subscribe and hit the bell!
https://youtube.com/sixoneindie

Support our work in the indie scene:
https://patreon.com/sixoneindie

Follow us:
Bluesky - https://bsky.app/profile/sixoneindie.com
All Links - https://www.sixoneindie.com/

Six One Indie is a dynamic collective committed to ensuring the voices driving the indie scene are heard loud and clear.
